annotations.title: Prepare a fresh QProof scan payment

description: Prepare a paid fresh QProof scan for an exact token ($0.25 per call). The signing wallet authorizes the payment. With an explicitly supplied signed x402 payment, verify the authorization and run a bounded scan before settlement. Settle only after required checks complete. No payment is submitted if a required check remains incomplete; the response marks charged:false and returns partial evidence when available. Reuse the same valid authorization for status/recovery.
name: qproof_scan
